name: Build Annubis Kernel (Proton)

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "cip" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - name: Checkout Kernel Source
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      with:
        fetch-depth: 1

    - name: Install Build Dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y bc build-essential zip curl libssl-dev flex bison libffi-dev libncurses-dev git-lfs python3 libarchive-tools

    - name: Setup Proton Clang
      run: |
        git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/kdrag0n/proton-clang.git clang
        echo "$(pwd)/clang/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

    - name: Build Kernel
      run: |
        export ARCH=arm64
        export SUBARCH=arm64
        export CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-linux-gnu-
        export CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32=arm-linux-gnueabi-
        
        # Bersihkan output lama jika ada
        mkdir -p out
        
        # Jalankan konfigurasi
        make O=out gale_defconfig
        
        # Proses Kompilasi
        make -j$(nproc --all) O=out \
                      CC=clang \
                      AR=llvm-ar \
                      NM=llvm-nm \
                      OBJCOPY=llvm-objcopy \
                      OBJDUMP=llvm-objdump \
                      STRIP=llvm-strip \
                      LD=ld.lld \
                      CROSS_COMPILE=aarch64-linux-gnu- \
                      CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32=arm-linux-gnueabi-

    - name: Check and Zip Output
      run: |
        if [ -f out/arch/arm64/boot/Image.gz-dtb ]; then
            echo "Build Success!"
            cd out/arch/arm64/boot/
            zip -r9 Annubis-Gale-Kernel.zip Image.gz-dtb
        else
            echo "Build Failed! Image.gz-dtb not found."
            exit 1
        fi

    - name: Upload Kernel Artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: Annubis-Kernel-Gale
        path: out/arch/arm64/boot/Annubis-Gale-Kernel.zip
